searchText: Post-merge we have an opportunity to get rid of the need to maintain deposit tree and the snapshot Good point - we can toss the whole lot out. Do we have specific proposals for that yet? I think mikhail had a proposal he shared earlier in one of the CL calls Here it is https://hackmd.io/@n0ble/HkOfKgH_c I am about to turn this into an EIP, consensus and Engine API spec changes some time soon ah yes thanks. I remember reading that now. Having to deal with validator indices potentially varying on different forks is a significant downside and going to be scary to implement, but it's going to have to happen unless we keep a long follow distance and that increases complexity in a bunch of other ways.
